name: Dawn’s Light
body:
School evocation [light]; Level bard 5, cleric/oracle 5, druid 5, inquisitor 5, magus 5, paladin 4, shaman 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, white necromancer 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a golden image of a sun)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Area 30-ft. radius
Duration concentration, up to 1 round/level
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

Create an area of radiant dawn in a 40-foot-high cylinder with a 30-foot radius. For the purposes of creatures harmed by sunlight, this is considered daylight. The light level is considered bright within the cylinder and for 30 feet outside and provides dim light out 60 further feet. Each creature beginning their turn within the area of sunlight or entering within must make a Fortitude save or take 1d6 positive energy damage/3 caster levels and be blinded until the beginning of their next turn. A successful Fortitude save halves the damage and reduces the blinded to dazzled until the beginning of their next turn. Creatures from the positive energy plane or made of light, like lurkers in light, are immune to the effects of this spell.
